concept.subject: A white lighthouse on a rocky point at the end of a curving breakwater, with lantern posts along the breakwater and two sea stacks offshore.
concept.composition: The lighthouse stands right of center at three fifths of the width, its lamp room and gallery at two fifths of the height and its tower tapering down to the rocks at the bottom. The breakwater curves from the lower left up toward the lighthouse's base. Two sea stacks rise on the left between a fifth and two fifths of the width to half height, the larger one pierced by an arch. Rows of waves roll along the bottom; the top center is open sky.
concept.layout: Round pegs only, 141, and the stage's one asymmetric board. The lighthouse's tower and lamp room are peg outlines with a ring of pegs around the gallery; the breakwater is a long peg line with a lantern peg on every post; the sea stacks and their arch are peg outlines; the wave crests are peg lines above the flippers' swing.

difficulty.note: The stage's hardest: the tower walls off the right half's middle and nothing slides balls back toward the bucket.

background.prompt: A white lighthouse with soft gray-blue bands stands on a rocky point in a sunny cove, right of the center at about three fifths of the picture width, its round lamp room and gallery at about two fifths of the picture height and its tapering tower reaching down to the rocks at the bottom. A long, curving stone breakwater runs from the lower left of the picture up toward the lighthouse's base, with small lantern posts along it. On the left, between about one fifth and two fifths of the width, two sea stacks rise from the water to about half the height, the larger one with a round arch through it. Rows of gentle waves with white foam lines roll across the clear aqua water at the bottom. A soft blue sky with a few small clouds; the top center is open sky; the lower corners are calm water.
